from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Captures the essential legal facts and title from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="Broad case type: 'Civil', 'Administrative', or 'Criminal'")
    core_dispute: str | None = Field(description="The primary legal relationship or dispute type, e.g., 'Product Liability', 'Lease Contract', 'Execution Objection'")
    specific_subject: str | None = Field(description="Specific subject matter that distinguishes similar cases, e.g., 'Forced Demolition', 'Info Disclosure', 'Property Crime', 'Execution Fine'")
    key_parties: list[str] | None = Field(description="Named parties or entities involved in the case")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
